eval.description: Anthropic lab-internal set of 33 biosecurity expert questions (written with Deloitte) on biological-weapons domain knowledge. External experts grade model answers against novice, intermediate, and expert human baselines from a 2024 baselining study. Cards report how many questions the model answers better than experts.
eval.summary: Measures how well the model answers expert questions about biological weapons compared with human experts.

versions.changes: Fixed 33-question set with human baselining; grading is manual and cards note high variance.

scores.description: Whether the model answer is graded better than the expert baseline for that question.

metrics.description: Count of questions (out of 33) answered better than domain experts.
